name: gpu-shepherd
description: Look after your own GPU Shepherd: check GPUs and apps, start and stop them, install apps and add models, with your OK before every change.

url.title: Dashboard address
url.description: Your GPU Shepherd's address as you open it in a browser, without a slash at the end, e.g. http://192.168.1.20:8090

api_token.title: API token
api_token.description: From the dashboard: Settings > API and command line. Whoever has it can do what the admin can.
